mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( category_id, title, author, publisher, isbn, description, stock, status ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{isbn}, #{description}, #{stock}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, isbn = #{isbn}, description = #{description}, stock = #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE book SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND stock > 0
